"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import * as HoverCardPrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-hover-card"
import { tw } from "~/tw";

const HoverCard = HoverCardPrimitive.Root

const HoverCardTrigger = HoverCardPrimitive.Trigger


const hoverCardContentHoverCardPrimitiveContent = tw.style({
    zIndex: "z-50",
    width: "w-64",
    borderRadius: "rounded-md",
    borderWidth: "border",
    backgroundColor: "bg-popover",
    padding: "p-4",
    color: "text-popover-foreground",
    boxShadow: "shadow-md",
    outlineStyle: "outline-none",
    transformOrigin: "origin-[--radix-hover-card-content-transform-origin]",
});

const HoverCardContent = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof HoverCardPrimitive.Content>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof HoverCardPrimitive.Content>
>(({ className, align = "center", sideOffset = 4, ...props }, ref) => (
  <HoverCardPrimitive.Content
    ref={ref}
    align={align}
    sideOffset={sideOffset}
    className={tw.join(tw.def(["data-[state=open]:animate-in", "data-[state=closed]:animate-out", "data-[state=closed]:fade-out-0", "data-[state=open]:fade-in-0", "data-[state=closed]:zoom-out-95", "data-[state=open]:zoom-in-95", "data-[side=bottom]:slide-in-from-top-2", "data-[side=left]:slide-in-from-right-2", "data-[side=right]:slide-in-from-left-2", "data-[side=top]:slide-in-from-bottom-2"], hoverCardContentHoverCardPrimitiveContent.style()), className)}
    {...props}
  />
))
HoverCardContent.displayName = HoverCardPrimitive.Content.displayName

export { HoverCard, HoverCardTrigger, HoverCardContent }
